g.text: ① Renderer process — a click on the left, a file change on the right
③ Main process — the only place a child process is created
④ Child processes — everything below this line is not this app

p.em: They are not the app's own colours.
Left column: a pane, started by a click.
Right column: a checker, started by a file change.

div.p:
Drawer
one "+ <label>" per configured
launcher, plus "+ shell".
Also the Bootstrap panel's button

createTerminals
sends { preset, cols, rows,
launcherId }. NEVER a command line.
64 000-char backlog before attach

Pane (xterm.js)
keystrokes, resize, and a file drop
that types a shell-quoted path
with NO trailing newline

Settings sheet
where the command line actually
lives. The renderer can write one
here and then start it by id

ProjectView + createDebtStore
refresh on mount and on EVERY
project event for this dir.
One in flight, one queued

DebtSection — "Not written up"
ordered unstamped, unswept,
unfiled, unlinked. A row opens a file
only if it is in this window's list

createApi
startPty · writePty · resizePty · killPty
setSettings · readDebt · onPtyEvent · onProjectEvent
a fixed method per fixed channel name

pty:start handler
startPtyInput: preset is an ENUM,
geometry 1..1000, launcherId <= 64.
Window id from the IPC sender

Registry
cwd = the window's project dir,
else the folder it last FAILED to
open. The renderer picks neither

SettingsStore + launcherFor
id -> command, via settings.json.
validateSettings: <= 8 rows,
label <= 40, command <= 200

PtyHost
4 panes per window, ids never reused,
owned() refuses write/resize/kill
from any other window

the spawner (index.ts)
node-pty, cwd = project,
xterm-256color, and a FULL copy of
process.env — nothing filtered

watchProject (chokidar)
CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, the wiki root,
the journal. 100 ms settle.
This is what makes checkers run

DebtHost
sha256 of each checker pinned on
FIRST SIGHT, refused if the bytes
later change. One round app-wide

runWith (execFile)
shell: false, 20 s, SIGKILL, 4 MB
stdout. Project dir is ONE argv
element. Exit code captured, never read

findPython (once, on ENOENT)
$SHELL -l -c 'command -v python3',
retried only if the answer is
an absolute path

$SHELL -l (shell preset)
$SHELL -l -i -c "<command>" (agent)
$SHELL falls back to /bin/zsh.
Full environment, cwd = the project

wiki-sweepcheck.py
--json --no-persist <dir>
every row read as kind unstamped.
No cwd option: inherits the app's

wiki-trigger.py
--json --no-persist <dir>
its own kind string is passed
through, anything else -> unlinked

skills/llmwiki/
resourcesPath when packaged,
appPath in development.
Only the entry script is hashed

settings.json (userData)
the launcher command lines.
Anything on the machine can edit
this file

g.text: a refusal sentence, never a crash
a login shell, to find python3
DebtReport { items, failed, checkedMs } — a path only if it is already in the list
